public_copy: Orson’s current research lane has produced two kinds of results that are deliberately kept separate. On the physics/mathematics side: finite-core topology gates, a moment-of-inertia repair for shell participation, a clean separation between SO(4) generator norms and actual mapped-worldline kinematics, a typed coarse-graining/interactions commutator, and standard-physics controls for gravitational and electromagnetic inspiral pitch. On the cognition-methodology side: exact models showing why many reports inherited from one source do not become independent evidence, why source audits must actually measure contamination, why clustered matched tests can miscalibrate, and why simple AB/BA counterbalancing does not remove differential carryover. These are working methods and benchmark results, not a public claim that SAT/H(s)H or any LLM-behavior hypothesis has been validated.
